name: Missing Required Parameters
expectedBehavior: 400 Bad Request indicating question or image is required.

name: Invalid Payload Types (Type Confusion)
description: Supplying array or number for string parameter 'question'.
expectedBehavior: 400 Bad Request with Zod schema validation error.

name: Oversized Request Body (> MAX_BODY_LIMIT)
description: Submitting payload exceeding maximum content length bounds.
expectedBehavior: 413 Payload Too Large or 400 Payload Exceeded Limit.

name: Extremely Long Prompt (> 50,000 Characters)
description: Submitting question string of 50,000 repeating characters to cause compute/memory DOS.
expectedBehavior: 400 Bad Request rejected by Zod length constraint or Request Guard.

name: Prototype Pollution Key Injection
description: Injecting '__proto__', 'constructor', or 'prototype' keys into JSON payload.
expectedBehavior: Payload parsed safely without prototype pollution; unknown keys ignored or rejected.

name: Rapid Burst Rate Limiting (100 Requests)
description: Simulates 100 concurrent rapid requests against rate limiter.
expectedBehavior: 429 Too Many Requests triggered to protect upstream Gemini quota.
